knowledge.content: Nginx server must listen on port 8080 (not default 80)

Custom log format requirements: timestamps ($time_local), request methods ($request_method), response status ($status), user agents ($http_user_agent with double quotes). Save to /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log
Rate limiting: 10 requests/second per IP, burst=10, 10MB memory zone. limit_req_zone goes in /etc/nginx/nginx.conf, limit_req goes in server block
Must disable default Nginx site by removing /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default
Custom 404 error page: serves /404.html with content "Page not found - Please check your URL"
index.html content must be exactly: "Welcome to the benchmark webserver"
Must test config with nginx -t before starting, then verify server is accessible on localhost:8080

Nginx.conf structure: http block starts at line 12, includes /etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf at line 59 and /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/* at line 60. Custom log format and limit_req_zone must be added inside the http block.

procedural.content: System is Debian GNU/Linux 12 (bookworm). Nginx is not installed, will need to install via apt.
Nginx 1.22.1 installed successfully via apt on Debian 12. Installation completed without errors. nginx-common and nginx packages installed from debian-security repository.
HTML files created successfully in /var/www/html. Directory already existed with a default index.nginx-debian.html file. Both index.html and 404.html created with exact required content.

status: Step 5 complete: nginx.conf file read successfully. File has default structure with http block starting at line 12. Next: modify nginx.conf to add custom log format (log_format benchmark) and rate limit zone (limit_req_zone), then create benchmark-site.conf server block, disable default site, test config, and start server.
